title: Mid-level iOS Developer
description: Mid-level iOS engineer capable of independently architecting complex applications using Clean Architecture/VIPER or TCA, managing Core Data / SwiftData persistence, developing WidgetKit extensions with App Groups, enforcing thread safety with Actors and @MainActor, optimizing UIKit/SwiftUI interoperability, and building automated XCUITest suites.

skills.rationale: Structuring applications with Clean Architecture/VIPER or TCA, and managing complex hierarchical child Coordinator trees.
Modeling relational storage with Core Data and SwiftData, building networking layers with Alamofire interceptors, and Keychain security.
Enforcing thread safety with Actors and @MainActor, bridging delegates with AsyncStream, and building reactive Combine pipelines.
Managing complex state with the Observable macro, bridging UIKit and SwiftUI with representables, and implementing NavigationStack.
Scheduling background tasks with BGTaskScheduler, developing WidgetKit extensions with App Groups, and configuring Universal Links.
Implementing generic abstractions with associated types, preventing ARC retain cycles with capture lists, and custom Error hierarchies.
Writing automated UI tests with XCUITest, integrating CoreLocation geofencing, and implementing Face ID / Touch ID biometrics.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in iOS architecture, Core Data persistence, or modern Swift concurrency.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Competent with basic MVVM, but struggles with Core Data background contexts, Actor isolation, or UIKit/SwiftUI bridging.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong systems grasp, independent feature delivery, solid Clean Architecture/TCA implementation, and proactive memory leak hunting.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: delivers robust Core Data/SwiftData apps, designs clean TCA/VIPER layers, and debugs complex concurrency.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level expectations with advanced SPM modularization, Swift Macros, and performance profiling expertise.
